text: Reception reported 91 of 183 rooms occupied on 20 Nov (49.7%), 43 of them Rabdan, with 0 check-ins and 2 check-outs (rooms 609 and 510). Its 19 Nov report, received the next morning, showed 94 occupied (51.4%), 44 Rabdan. Renewals: 1 confirmed and 7 pending. Reception received 4 guest complaints and closed all 4.
Reports for 20 Nov received from Operations, Reception, Maintenance, IT, HR & Admin, Accounts, the Flower shop and AJ1881. The Housekeeping report was not seen.

ADNOC (50 premium rooms) and the Ras Al Khaimah client (15 premium rooms, 5 days) are both still waiting on the client’s response. Operations completed 4 client site visits; Reception logged 1 new inquiry, 1 viewing and 1 booking confirmation. AJ1881 sold AED 94 from 3 covers, all beverages, with low foot traffic; the flower shop recorded no sales.

Maintenance completed 8 jobs on 20 Nov, including a basement glass door handle, room 912 ceiling painting, a room 304 wall light, a room 1202 cupboard and a main-entrance key cylinder. Still pending: the basement lift lobby painting, room 706 thermostat, basement parking lights and other basement painting. Solo Energy inspected the calorifier and boiler leak; results are pending.

IT resolved all 5 complaints (room 1108 key card, reception printer, maintenance PC, room 609 Wi-Fi and TV), installed an outside CCTV camera and lists 13 cameras still to install. The new Etisalat plan has been taken and the technical visit is set for Sunday 22 Nov. The Equal software is still slow.

For the Oui Cafe, Operations received a Foodics POS quotation, ran a chef trial for grab-and-go items, had the signage measured and followed up PAL Group on the outdoor seating; the Al Khayam quotation is still pending. The flower shop prepared a collaboration proposal with LUO OUI Pilates.

A new guest check-in and check-out policy was issued to staff. Security prepared a detailed room status report. Operations asked St Regis to confirm the Pilates studio start date and updated the status of the guest involved in the 18 Nov incident.

Awaiting decision: the facility management AMC proposal (BMS, lift, Tamouh), elevator AMC renewal, room 710 FCU rewinding, the lobby partition concern, the MBG accounting and VAT proposal, the AJ1881 rename and supplies purchase, the Pilates studio start and housekeeping, the final driver selection, and pending offer letters and visa processing.
